description: R-03 (Tiers from posterior means and expected ranks, pages/rules/posterior-tiers.qmd): the theory book's ch. 19 three-unit law cut along its expected-rank order B, C, A, against the exact optimum within all 13 reports and the cuts of the posterior-mean order A, B, C, at tau = 1/4 and 1/2; the sizes of the two families. League, eight-unit and 30-site values are already in part3.json (league.default.prior15.*, league8.*, thirty.poverty.*) and are not repeated.

r03.tb19.e.note: theory book ch. 19 three-unit law (the same input as tb19.law3.e in part3.json)

r03.tb19.er.note: expected ranks (2.4, 1.3, 2.3): the order B, C, A

r03.tb19.ercuts.tau25.note: optimal cuts of the expected-rank order at tau = 1/4

r03.tb19.all.tau25.note: the exact optimum within all 13 reports at tau = 1/4

r03.tb19.ercuts.tau50.note: optimal cuts of the expected-rank order at tau = 1/2

r03.tb19.pmcuts.tau50.note: optimal cuts of the posterior-mean order A, B, C at tau = 1/2

r03.tb19.all.tau50.note: the exact optimum within all 13 reports at tau = 1/2

r03.tb19.family.order.size.note: the contiguous cuts of one declared order of three units

r03.tb19.ercuts.tau25.grades.note: the cuts of B, C, A at tau = 1/4: B above A and C

r03.tb19.all.tau25.grades.note: the exact optimum within all 13 reports at tau = 1/4

r03.tb19.ercuts.tau50.grades.note: the cuts of B, C, A at tau = 1/2: the full order B, C, A

r03.tb19.pmcuts.tau50.grades.note: the cuts of A, B, C at tau = 1/2
